profile.summary: A California state agency that provides unemployment benefits, disability insurance and paid family leave. It also offers job training services and administers payroll taxes for employers.

review.notes: EDD is California's only state agency of this name, it is based in Sacramento, and the agenda lists an EDD grant, so identity is solid; the summary matches edd.ca.gov and is neutral. The PO Box is one of several program-specific mailing addresses on the Contact page and not a general agency address, so it is dropped.
